categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, survey plans, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena, Minister of Lands), this is incidental to the primary purpose of the document, which is land acquisition matters. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
